11	Excitement formula for twister RC lives in `/tmp/openrct2-src/src/openrct2/ride/rtd/coaster/TwisterRollerCoaster.h`
12	(`.RatingsData`) plus `ride/RideRatings.cpp`. Base excitement 3.50. Measured levers, biggest first:
13	
14	- **Inversions**: `min(inv,6) * 27.33` pre-multiplier, x0.408 => ~0.67 excitement at 6 inversions.
15	  Intensity cost only ~0.27 each. Always go to exactly 6.
16	- **Sharp 60-degree crests** (round-2 win, +0.15): geometry-preserving swaps that raise negative G
17	  from -0.85 to -2.43 (excitement clamps at -2.50). Drop-in replacements, same tiles AND same dz:
18	  - 6 tiles dz0: `flat_to_up_25,up_25,up_25_to_flat,flat_to_down_25,down_25,down_25_to_flat`
19	    -> `flat_to_up_25,up_25_to_up_60,up_60_to_flat,flat_to_down_60,down_60_to_down_25,down_25_to_flat`
20	  - 4 tiles dz0: `flat_to_up_25,up_25_to_flat,flat_to_down_25,down_25_to_flat`
21	    -> `flat_to_up_60,up_60_to_flat,flat_to_down_60,down_60_to_flat`
22	  Converting ~4 hops is the sweet spot; converting ALL of them scored 7.08 vs 7.09 (no further gain).
23	- **Air time**: `excitement += min(airtime,200)/8` applied directly (not scaled). Saturates in practice
24	  around 100; going 100 -> 108 gained nothing. Not a lever worth chasing.
25	- **Proximity** (x0.307) is the biggest UNTAPPED lever - see [[rct2-proximity-bonus-plan]].
26	- **G-forces** (x0.375): lateral-G excitement CAPPED at 1.50; excess is pure intensity. But the
27	  excessive-lateral PENALTY only fires above 2.80 (intensity/nausea) and 3.10 (halves excitement).
28	  At 2.52 there is no penalty, so don't waste effort banking turns. Positive G is a bad trade:
29	  excitement mult 5242 vs intensity 52428 (10x worse).
30	- **Drops**: excitement caps at 9 drops. Highest-drop-height contribution is tiny.
31	- **Sheltered** (`ride_ratings_get_sheltered_ratings`, up to ~0.6 excitement) is UNREACHABLE:
32	  `TrackGetIsSheltered` only counts largeScenery/path/smallScenery above the track, not your own
33	  track, and the MCP tools cannot place scenery. Don't chase it.
34	- **Length/duration**: nearly worthless (`min(len,6000)*764>>16`; 660 length ~ 0.08).
35	- Intensity penalty only triggers at intensity >= 10.00. Round 2 sat at 8.60 - headroom remains.
36	- Similarity: round-1 layout was 0.469 (0.5 = penalty starts). The 60-degree crest swaps dropped it
37	  to 0.392, so this change helps on both axes.
38

40	the flat return leg replaced by a ~35-tile ground-level serpentine (right_turn_5, 10 s_bends, 6 flats,

11	`BonusProximity` multiplier is 20130/65536 = **x0.307** on `ride_ratings_get_proximity_score`
12	(RideRatings.cpp ~1379). Raw score x 0.307 = rating units; 100 rating units = 1.00 excitement.
13	
14	## Full payout table (RideRatings.cpp:1382-1408), best first
15	| Bonus | helper | hits to cap | excitement |
16	|---|---|---|---|
17	| TRACK_THROUGH_VERTICAL_LOOP | h2(+4, cap6, x20) | **2** | **+0.37** |
18	| INTERSECTING_VERTICAL_LOOP | h3(100) | **1** | **+0.31** |
19	| THROUGH_VERTICAL_LOOP | h2(+4, cap6, x10) | 2 | +0.18 |
20	| OWN_STATION_TOUCH_ABOVE | h3(55) | 1 | +0.17 |
21	| OWN_TRACK_TOUCH_ABOVE | h2(+10, cap15, x3.33) | 5 | +0.15 |
22	| OWN_TRACK_CLOSE_ABOVE | h1(cap5, x6) | 5 | +0.09 |
23	| OWN_STATION_CLOSE_ABOVE | h3(25) | 1 | +0.08 |
24	| SURFACE_TOUCH | h1(cap70, x1.71) | 70 | +0.37 but MEASURED DUD (see below) |
25	
26	Loop bonuses stack: **0.37+0.31+0.18 = +0.86** from one well-placed crossing.
27	
28	## MEASURED (round 3): SURFACE_TOUCH is NOT worth chasing
29	~60 ground-level elements added; excitement only 7.09 -> 7.12, and intensity 8.60 -> 9.08 from the
30	turns' lateral G ate the gain. Don't redo.
31	
32	## The loop-under-lift recipe (round 4, designed but NOT finished - do this first next round)
33	Conditions (`ride_ratings_score_close_proximity_loops_helper`, line 634): for each vertical-loop
34	element the game scans the loop's own tile AND the tile in front. Another **track** element there
35	scores if `(dirA ^ dirB) & 1` (90 degrees) and `other.baseHeight - loopElement.baseHeight` in
36	**[0,16] units = [0,128] z**. If that other element is itself a vertical loop, INTERSECTING also fires.
37	
38	The cheap way to satisfy it: **the lift hill already runs along x at y=60.** Put a ground-level
39	vertical loop travelling along +/-y so its footprint covers a `y=60` lift tile. No altitude
40	gymnastics needed - the loop stays on the ground and the lift is the perpendicular crossing element.
41	
42	Verified round-4 numbers for the standard skeleton (station (60,60) dir 0, 4 station + 15 chain pieces):
43	- lift tiles x=42..56 at y=60; **lift top z=256 at x=41**; z(x) ~= 256 - (x-42)*9.6
44	- post-drop ground track is at **z=128** (not 112), cursor lands at (35,60,128) dir 0
45	- a loop based at z=128 tops out at **z=232** -> needs the lift above it, so target **x=42 or 43**
46	  (lift z ~256 / ~246). x=45+ is z<=228 and will collide.
47	- zDiff test passes easily: 256-128 = 128 z = exactly 16 units, and higher loop elements pass too.
48	
49	## Turn direction rule (cost me round 4 - I guessed wrong)
50	**left turn => dir-1 mod 4; right turn => dir+1 mod 4.** dir 0=-x, 1=+y, 2=+x, 3=-y.
51	So from dir 2 (+x) you need `right_turn_3/5` to face dir 3 (-y). I used left_turn_3 and ended up at
52	dir 1 heading +y, which put the loop at y=67-71 - nowhere near the lift - and ran out of clock.
53	Rotating a piece delta from dir 0 to dir 3: `(dx,dy) -> (-dy, dx)`. left_vertical_loop is
54	(-2,-1) at dir 0, so **(+1,-2) at dir 3**.
55	
56	## Also still untried
57	- `OWN_STATION_TOUCH_ABOVE`: fly track over a station tile at exactly **z=128** (station z=112,
58	  clearanceHeight 16). No perpendicular requirement - condition is just
59	  `stationElement.clearanceHeight == flyoverElement.baseHeight` (line 816). Cheap +0.17.
60	
61	See [[rct2-twister-rating-levers]].

Round 5 done. Score banked: **7.12 excitement**.

**What happened:**
1. Rebuilt my known-good 104-piece layout from notes and tested immediately — **7.12 excitement / 9.08 intensity / 4.79 nausea, 6 inversions, similarity 0.338**. Banked in the first two calls.
2. Spent the rest of the budget on the untried proximity bonus. I read `RideRatings.cpp` to confirm the exact scoring conditions (`ride_ratings_score_close_proximity_loops_helper`: a 90°-crossing track element with `baseHeight` 0–16 units above the loop element scores `TRACK_THROUGH_VERTICAL_LOOP`, worth ~+0.55 excitement combined with `THROUGH_VERTICAL_LOOP`).
3. Computed the lift-hill height profile from `piece_geometry`, routed a return leg that crosses under the lift, and **got a vertical loop successfully placed under the lift hill at the one tile that satisfies both the clearance and the zDiff window** — after three rejected placements narrowed down the sweet spot.

**Where it fell short:** the circuit closed, but the test never completed — `tested: false`, excitement `null`, and `ride_length` growing from 3852 to 4877 as I raised the tick count. That's a valleyed train: it can't carry enough speed to a 7th inversion at z=136 that late in the ride. Not a crash, but not a scoring run either. My attempt to lower the loop by 16z to save energy was rejected for collision, and I ran out of clock before I could add energy instead.

I've written the verified geometry, the exact accepted piece sequence, the three rejected variants, and the energy fix (lengthen the chain lift — it extends west, so the x=48 arithmetic is unaffected — or add a `booster` on the approach flats) to memory for round 6.

**Best coaster: the 104-piece twister — 14-tile chain lift, 60° plunge, 3 vertical loops and 3 corkscrew pairs snaking across y-lanes, ground-level serpentine return — at 7.12 excitement.**
